ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to 6 months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within 30 days after such expiry or termination, return all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added Section 10.3 because Section 10 gives us no right to migration help or to get Customer Data back (and Section 16.5 cross-refers to a Section 11 that does not exist). Consistent with our playbook exit position, the 30-day return runs from expiry or termination itself, uses a standard machine-readable format, and deletion with written certification follows return.
proposal.summary: Insert Section 10.3 requiring up to 6 months' transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiry or termination, and certified deletion thereafter.
